notes: This dataset contains the experimental and statistical data relating to a research project on emotive factives like "be happy" and "regret", as well as a manuscript. This repository encompasses the following directories: - `paper` contains a manuscript associated with the experiment (`paper/factivity.pdf`) and the proceedings paper cited above. - `data` contains all the experimental data - `scripts` contains the R script that analyzes the data and creates the figures. Note that the R scripts assume the folder structure of this repository - `figs` contains all of the data visualizations generated (as PDF files). Since the theme script is not included here, recreating the images from the associated R code will lead to slightly different aesthetics
